rca_of_issue: Root cause: legacy update_one calls at server.py:5519 and 5534 wrote `updated_at` as a raw datetime object (not .isoformat()), producing docs like {updated_at: datetime(2026,7,2,17,11,29)}. When get_or_create_profile() loaded such a doc, Profile(**doc) raised ValidationError because Profile.updated_at is typed str. The `except Exception: pass` at line 1661 silently swallowed the error and fell through to the create-fresh branch, overwriting the real 634-msg profile with an empty one. On the mobile client this manifested as intermittent empty profile loads → LoginScreen loop → then WS voice/stream endpoint saw uid='me' after auth-bridge cache miss → tried to load profile inside stream handler → same ValidationError inside dependency → connection abort → client saw code=1006. Fix layers applied: (a) coerce datetime→isoformat before Pydantic (server.py:1610-1613); (b) replace raw datetime writes with .isoformat() at line 5531/5546; (c) DB repair pass on 4 corrupted docs; (d) eas.json points production/preview/preview-android to https://app-finder-408.preview.emergentagent.com. Reproduction (before fix): mongosh 'db.taccuino_profile.updateOne({id:"me"},{$set:{updated_at:new Date()}})' → GET /api/profile → empty profile. After fix: same command → GET /api/profile → Fabio 634 (coercion neutralises the sabotage). Verified with 13/13 tests + MongoDB inspection.
